selected_evidence.summary: Shows /dev/vg_data/lv_data formatted as XFS and mounted at /srv/data before growth and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Grow to at least 2 GB while mounted with contents intact
selected_evidence.summary: The LV grew from 1024 MiB to 2304 MiB; mount ID remained 407 and the proof-file SHA-256 remained b9ee528fcbbffe800b3f884094a3b9ac9cdcb82e31e791d4c5d82b3de3483590.
Shows the enabled activation service, dependent fstab mount, and successful automatic recovery after reboot.

Captures the healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged reboot, boot ID change from f54d7366-0403-4b05-93bb-b5c0a1818892 to 2155fce5-be59-4255-83a2-4a054aed6142, and recovered LV, mount, proof data, SSH service, and zero failed units.

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/activate-data-loop >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
image=/var/lib/lvm-data/data-pv.img
loopdev=$(losetup -j "$image" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')
if [ -z "$loopdev" ]; then
    loopdev=$(losetup --find --show "$image")
fi
pvscan --cache "$loopdev"
vgchange -ay vg_data
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/activate-data-loop
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/data-loop.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Attach persistent backing device for vg_data
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-remount-fs.service
Before=local-fs-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/activate-data-loop
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=sysinit.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
sudo awk '$2 != "/srv/data" {print}' /etc/fstab | sudo tee /etc/fstab.new >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' '/dev/vg_data/lv_data /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=data-loop.service,x-systemd.after=data-loop.service 0 0' | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab.new >/dev/null
sudo mv /etc/fstab.new /etc/fstab
sudo restorecon -v /usr/local/sbin/activate-data-loop /etc/systemd/system/data-loop.service /etc/fstab /var/lib/lvm-data/data-pv.img /srv/data 2>/dev/null || true
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable data-loop.service
sudo systemctl start data-loop.service
printf 'UNIT_STATE='; systemctl is-enabled data-loop.service; systemctl is-active data-loop.service
printf 'FSTAB='; awk '$2=="/srv/data" {print}' /etc/fstab
printf 'MOUNT_UNIT_DEPS\n'; systemctl show srv-data.mount -p Requires -p After
